 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Rohit Sharma continues to be part of the Indian cricket team as the Men in Blue lock horns with New Zealand in the first match of the five-game ODI series being played in Auckland on Wednesday.
 The veteran opening batter will look to maintain his form after a successful outing against West Indies on home conditions last month.

 Rohit Sharma's score in last five ODIs
